about: Airdrie is immediately north of Calgary on the Queen Elizabeth II Highway, in Rocky View County’s urban shadow. It has grown rapidly from a small prairie town into a suburban city of new neighbourhoods around Nose Creek. Many residents commute into Calgary; the city also has its own civic centre and recreation facilities. About 74,000 people live in Airdrie.
